Why Godfreys

A better way to clean your gutters.

Most gutter cleaners show up, chuck the leaves on your lawn, and send an invoice. Here's what's actually different about working with us.

Industrial vacuum, not just a scoop

High-powered industrial vacuum equipment reaches further and clears finer debris than a scoop-and-scrape job ever will — less mess left behind, less time on your roof.

Before & after, every job

No "trust me." You get photo proof of what came out of your gutters and what they look like clean — sent straight to you.

We fix the cause, not just the symptom

Overhanging branches are usually the reason your gutters clog up in the first place. We'll trim them back as part of the job if that's what it takes to keep your gutters clear.

Fully insured, no shortcuts

Public liability covered on residential, commercial and strata jobs — so you're never carrying the risk on someone else's roof.

Fast, straight answers

Message or call and get a real quote back quickly — no call centres, no "someone will be in touch."

Owner on every job

You're dealing with Peter directly — not a rotating crew of subcontractors who've never seen your property before.

What We Do

Gutter cleaning is what we do best.

Vacuum-based gutter clearing is our core service. We also trim back the trees that keep causing the blockage — so the problem doesn't just come back next season.

Core Service

Gutter Vacuuming

Full clear-out using professional vacuum equipment — no leaf litter left dumped on your roof or in your yard.

  • Residential homes, all roof types
  • Commercial properties
  • Strata & multi-unit buildings
  • Downpipe checks & flow test
Add-On

Tree Services

Trim back what's causing the clog in the first place. Overhanging limbs and canopy growth cleared away from your roofline.

  • Overhanging branch removal
  • Canopy trimming near rooflines
  • Storm-damage limb clearing
  • Green waste removed on request
Ongoing

Maintenance Plans

Set-and-forget scheduling so your gutters get cleared before the next big wind or wet season hits.

  • Seasonal or annual visits
  • Priority booking for regulars
  • Photo report after every clean
  • Bundle with a tree tidy-up
